read_file.summary: Reads a file of the app.
params: the name of the file, without extension; folders with `/`
`'text'` (a list of lines), `'json'`, `'nbt'`, `'raw'`, and the `'shared_...'` versions of each
read_file.returns: the content: a list of lines, the value read from json, an NBT tag; `null` when the file is not there.
read_file.note: Every app writes under `<world>/blossom/<app>.data/`; the `shared_` types go to `<world>/blossom/shared/`, which is the intended way to pass data between apps.

write_file.summary: Writes a file of the app - appending, when the type is textual.
params: the name of the file, without extension
examples: file.write_file('audit', 'text', ['ada joined']);   // adds at the end
write_file.note: `'text'` appends, `'json'` and `'nbt'` replace: a log grows, a state is overwritten.

delete_file.summary: Deletes a file of the app.
params: the name of the file, without extension

list_files.summary: The files of a folder of the app.
params: the folder to read; `''` is the root of the app
the type of the files to list

load_app_data.summary: The state of the app, read from NBT without thinking about paths.
params: optional: a state file other than the default one
load_app_data.returns: `nbt` — the saved state, `null` on the first run.

store_app_data.summary: Saves the state of the app as NBT.
params: optional: a state file other than the default one
store_app_data.note: Together with `load_app_data` it is the shortest way to survive a restart: no path, no format to choose.

create_datapack.summary: Creates a datapack from the given content and turns it on.
params: a map from path to file content
create_datapack.returns: `bool` — whether it was created; `null` when a pack with that name is already there.
